title: Morning Brief — Thursday, 8 October 2026
description: Rising coffee prices after the card surcharge ban and a national crackdown on illegal tobacco shops, Queensland's own tobacco blitz boosting legal sales and Logan's halved granny flat charge, plus a record 14.7 million visitors to the Gold Coast and the return of the Groundwater Country Music Festival. 한국어로도 브리핑을 전해드립니다.

show.channel_description: A short daily news brief covering Australian national news, Queensland, and the Gold Coast — made to listen to on the morning drive.
